headline: Committee sets ʻOhana Assistance Program minimum, cuts $140,000 for new positions

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Add pending department grants to Appendix A, Part 1
meeting.summary: Members voted with nine ayes to add missing license classes to the liquor fee list and to set at least $3 million for ʻOhana Assistance Program grants. A $35,000 Personnel Services cut failed. The meeting continues tomorrow at 10.
meeting.recap: State law caps an underage drinking prevention program at $22,000, so members could not add money to it.[[0:01:52]] Members voted with nine ayes to add missing license classes to the liquor fee list.[[0:04:39]] Members cut $140,000 meant for new positions in a second department's budget, with nine ayes.[[0:09:06]] Members voted with nine ayes to list that department's pending grants in the budget ahead of time.[[0:19:51]] A member proposed cutting $35,000 from Personnel Services for rented training space.[[0:21:33]] The cut failed in a roll-call vote.[[0:27:32]] Members cut $150,000 from the Planning Department, based on past unspent money, with nine ayes.[[0:30:00]] A motion would add $170,000 for security at the bus hub.[[0:40:02]] A member proposed letting students of any age with a valid ID ride the bus fare free.[[0:45:20]] A motion set that at least $3 million may go to ʻOhana Assistance Program grants of up to $100,000 each.[[1:03:34]] It passed with nine ayes.[[1:05:30]] The meeting is set to continue tomorrow at 10.[[1:10:44]]
decided: Members approved listing the department's pending grants in Appendix A, Part 1.
Members cut $150,000 from the Planning Department's Category A.
A vote was called on adding $170,000 for bus hub security, but the result is not in the recording.
The outcome of the student bus fare amendment is not in the recording.
meeting.next: Members plan to take up Human Concerns, Management, the Mayor, Parks, and Police next. A member asked that a police bond-funding offset be sent in writing for when members review Police.

moments.q: "It's on behalf of the county for things seen and unseen"
Confusion over the Personnel roll-call count

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

issues.oneLine: Members set that at least $3 million may go to ʻOhana Assistance Program grants.
issues.why: The chair wanted to make sure the program keeps at least $3 million if the fund's $11 million is used elsewhere.
issues.next: A speaker said the department was told by text that members want it to award $3 million next year.
issues.brief: The grants are up to $100,000 each for qualified Maui County residents in the ʻohana assistance program.[[#1]] The ʻohana assistance condition passed with nine ayes.[[#2]]
